package: DEV-AUTO-2: a live Frame C revision course on the repaired wiring, development level
what_this_is_not: not the formal A3/A5 main experiment
development level only: every unit here is already exposed
no sealed data, no TARGET_HELD_IN unit and no +144 face was read
no known-good program was supplied to or hinted at the model

acceptance_rule.rule: Frame C.  A proposal that is legal, and whose Scope clause the tool could calibrate, enters the verification queue.  The replay over the units this arm has already processed is measured and reported, but it does not refuse the candidate: it orders the queue and it comes back to you as feedback.  Entering the queue is not acceptance and carries no deployment right -- the candidate is only offered to later units, Fast decides whether to probe or deploy it, and the Skill is patched only after an independent later unit passes the authoritative delayed gate.
acceptance_rule.queue_order: Queued candidates are ordered by, in this order: (1) the common-denominator utility difference against the parent over the units already processed, larger first; (2) fewer cells where the pair is confirmed not executable and falls back to raw, because a program that cannot run on the cells already seen is less likely to run on the next one; (3) the position it was proposed at, then the order the model returned it.  Every input is a reading on evidence that has already arrived; no later unit, no later face and no future score enters the key.

proposals.what_changes: Replaces the frozen MAD outlier filter with an IQR-based outlier filter, which uses a different spread estimator and will modify a different set of series.
proposals.expected_change: Expected to change treatment of series T108, T109, T115, and T118 — the series that lost under outlier_mad — and possibly reduce the worst single-series harm (0.165) while preserving gains on the 13 series that gained in the support face.

proposals.what_changes: Replaces the MAD outlier filtering with winsorization, which caps extreme values rather than removing/replacing them, changing the skew correction mechanism entirely.
proposals.expected_change: Expected to affect the same high local_robust_z_peak series in scope, but with a softer transformation; likely to reduce harm on T108 and T115 while retaining gains on most treated series.

proposals.what_changes: Replace the frozen outlier_mad step with a hampel_filter, an effect-distinct mechanism that flags isolated spikes via a rolling window rather than a global MAD threshold, targeting the same high-local-robust-z series but with different failure modes.
proposals.expected_change: Expected to improve the gate-failing harmed_fraction and single_series_harm lines: the delayed face loss on T108, T109, T115, T118 should shrink, and the worst single_series_harm (0.165) should drop below the 0.3 risk bound, while most of the 10 gaining series retain their benefit.

proposals.what_changes: Narrow the serving scope to series where the high robust-z peak occupies a relatively early region (outlier_region_end_fraction bounded above), excluding series whose outlier region extends late into the series.
proposals.expected_change: Expected to exclude T108, T109, T115, and T118 — all late-region outliers that lost under the current program — while retaining most of the 10 gaining early/mid-region series, thereby improving the harmed_fraction and single_series_harm lines.

actual_cost.counting: every physical fit, including the ones spent inside a call that then raised; no allowance carried over

ledgers.course_fits_cover: the delayed gate and the evaluation face
ledgers.support_fits_note: Support probe fits, counted only where the evaluator reported them; probes that reported none are counted as unrecorded rather than as zero.  Courses run before this counter existed have no Support line at all and their Support cost stays a derivation, not a reading
ledgers.baseline_note: the reference model, shared by every arm on a unit because it is cached per (executor, origin).  COMPLETED executions and cache hits are counted; they are not folded into support_fits and not priced, because the injected evaluator reports no fit count and charging a shared model is an open protocol question
ledgers.baseline_evaluations_is_not_a_fit_total: it counts completed reference evaluations, one per (executor, origin).  What each one costs the Consumer is not reported by the injected evaluator, so this line must not be read as, or added to, a total of Consumer fits
ledgers.unmeasured_cost_note: an evaluation that raised inside the Consumer had already spent an unrecoverable amount: scoped_evaluate reports consumer_fits only on a normal return.  Those are counted here as unmeasured rather than added to any total as zero
ledgers.why_no_llm_prompt_cache: wiring CachedAgentBackend would change what the arms are charged for and how their proposals diverge; it is not enabled for HEC-1 and its absence is recorded rather than left as a zero that looks like a miss rate

guard.why_before: a post-hoc budget check pays for the call it refuses; this one refuses first and bills nothing
